title: Momentum Pinball on 4h UTC blocks: LBR/RSI(3) below 30, then 15m first-hour high breakout
ex_ante_rule: Chart 15m, closed bars only, all times UTC. A signal at a bar close fills at the next bar open. BLOCKS: 4-hour UTC blocks starting at 00:00, 04:00, 08:00, 12:00, 16:00 and 20:00. Each block has 16 bars, numbered 1-16 by open time (bar 1 opens at the block start, bar 16 opens at block start + 3h45m). Block close C(k) = close of bar 16 of block k. LBR/RSI: x(k) = C(k) - C(k-1). LBR(k) = Wilder RSI with length 3 computed on the series x (not on price): up(k) = max(x(k) - x(k-1), 0), down(k) = max(x(k-1) - x(k), 0), each smoothed with Wilder's average (alpha = 1/3, recursive), LBR = 100 - 100/(1 + avgUp/avgDown); LBR = 100 if avgDown = 0. LBR(k) is known only at the close of bar 16 of block k and is forward-filled onto the bars of block k+1. SETUP: block k+1 is armed if LBR(k) < 30. OPENING RANGE of an armed block: ORH = max high and ORL = min low of its bars 1-4 (the first hour). ENTRY (long, only when flat on the pair): on the first bar among bars 5-12 of the armed block whose close > ORH and whose ATR(14)/close >= 0.004 (ATR = Wilder ATR, length 14, true range on 15m bars), buy at the next bar open E. At most one entry per block: after an entry in a block, no further entry signal in that block, even after an exit. STOP: stop price S = min(ORL, 0.99*E), fixed once at entry and never moved, triggered intrabar when the low touches it (implement with custom_stoploss returning the fixed price relative to E; native stoploss = -0.05 as the outer backstop, so a stop distance wider than 5% is capped at 5%). TAKE-PROFIT: sell at E*1.015 (gross, before fees) when a bar high touches it. BLOCK-END LOSER EXIT: at the close of bar 16 of the entry block, if that close < E, sell at the next bar open (first bar of the next block). TIME EXIT: otherwise hold until stop, take-profit, or the bar close at entry time + 11h45m, then sell at the next open (holding at most 48 bars = 12 h). Whichever exit comes first applies. No cooldown other than the one-entry-per-block rule. No daily or higher-timeframe filter. Same rule and numbers on all nine pairs. Warm-up: 1600 bars (100 blocks of 16 bars so the recursive Wilder RSI(3) on block changes and the Wilder ATR(14) are fully converged; the scout's longest lookback was 320 bars).
rationale: Raschke and Connors' Momentum Pinball: a 3-period RSI of the 1-period change below 30 marks a short, sharp burst of selling (momentum and stop-loss sellers). The next session's first-hour high being taken out confirms that sellers are exhausted and late shorts/hedges are covering, so the long buys a reversal already under way rather than a falling knife. The counterparties are the forced and momentum sellers who created the oversold reading and the short-term shorts who must cover above the first-hour high. In crypto, a 4h UTC block plays the role of the source's day, keeping trades intraday. The source's loser rule (never carry a losing position past the session) is kept as the block-end loser exit; the source has no target, the scout's idea adds 1.5% and a 12 h time cap as the owner requires. Activity filter (a), fixed: 15m ATR(14)/close >= 0.4%, so each trade happens only when bars are already wide; the stop is at least 1% away (cost under 0.3R at the 0.30% base round trip). Expected trades: about 2190 blocks a year; LBR<30 arms roughly a quarter of them (~500), and a first-hour-high close in hours 2-3 with the ATR filter fires in perhaps a third, so ~150-250 trades per pair per year (0.4-0.7 per day per pair, 4-6 per day over nine pairs). Expected gross move: exits sit 1-1.5% away (stop >=1%, target 1.5%), losers are cut at block end before full stop, so a 50-55% hit rate gives roughly +0.5% gross per trade, above the 0.30% base and near the 0.45% conservative round trip. In a falling market the setup arms more often but the breakout confirmation is required; in chop it is a mean-reversion-after-burst rule, which is what the owner's lesson (c) asks for.
novelty_vs_tried: No family in the context uses a Momentum Pinball setup (RSI(3) of the one-period change on 4h block closes) as an arming condition. SessionOpeningRangeBreakout (capped) and AsianRangeLondonBreakout broke opening ranges unconditionally at fixed session opens; here the first-hour breakout is only taken after an oversold burst in the previous 4h block, so it is a confirmed reversal, not a continuation breakout. DailyRSI2Dip and Double7ChannelDip buy daily dips at the close without intraday confirmation; HourlyFailedBreakdownReclaim and SessionRangeJudasSweep need a sweep of a low. The block-end loser exit (cut losers at the end of the session, carry only winners up to 12 h) is also an exit structure not used by earlier rules.
